findings.detail: Real code reachable through /api/apps. Install (controller.go:221 Install → regenAndRebuild:304) persists intent to apps.json (store.go WriteApps) and writes a ONE-WAY drop-in local/20-apps.nix (store.go GenerateDropin:95 → `environment.systemPackages = [ pkgs.<x> ];`, no reverse parse), then kicks the EXISTING S673a42 unit via deployRebuildPort.TriggerRebuild → deploy.TriggerRebuild (rebuild.go:50, rebuildUnit='palmux-rebuild.service', pre-existing, NOT in the diff → no duplicate rebuild plumbing, priority_rule 6 honored). GET /api/apps (handler_apps.go:19 → controller List:97) returns catalog∪custom cards with installReach/shareBoundary/installBoundary/shareReach meta (AC-1-2). AC-1-4: shared_profile.go:190 adds nix-store(ro)+nix-sysbin(ro, EvalSymlinks-resolved) devices and setEnvPath(nixContainerPATH) at Ensure:342 — all gated on os.Stat('/nix/store')==nil so Ubuntu hosts are untouched (TestNixDevicesAbsentWithoutStore). AC-1-5: nixvalidate.go ValidatePackage charset-guards then `nix eval --raw nixpkgs#<n>.name`; nix-missing → Unavailable (never silent valid); non-zero → Invalid, no rebuild. flakeDir is env-overridable (PALMUX_NIXOS_FLAKE_DIR, default /persist/palmux/nixos), no hardcode-only.

Single-source binding confirmed by call path: apps.Controller.Share (controller.go:333) → c.shared.ApplySharedDirs → deploy.Controller.ApplySharedDirs (deploy/controller.go:184) → config.WriteMaster [workspace].shared_dirs + hot.SetSharedDirs (same persist+propagate path as the generic 共有フォルダ list; other master sections preserved). The e2e (s41bdf2_app_cards.py:131) and acceptance (s41bdf2_apps_backend.py:115) BOTH read GET /api/deploy sharedDirs back and assert the auth path appears — the app card and generic list provably point at one source (AC-2-1). AC-2-2 従属 is enforced server-side: Share() returns error 'is not installed — install before sharing' (controller.go:350) → handler 400 (handler_apps.go:98); test asserts st==400 for a not-installed app (backend:107). UI mirrors with aria-disabled + disabled + rowDisabled (apps-section.tsx:188,256,259). AC-2-3: single palmux-shared mold (no per-container), $HOME-scope reuse via config.ExpandSharedDir (controller.go:361).

AppsSection rendered inside the Deploy settings tab (settings-panel.tsx:996 <AppsSection/>) → reachable through the GUI. 1アプリ=1カード with install+share toggles, every interactive element data-testid'd (apps-section.tsx). Install chip '要 rebuild（軽・即）' (line 216), share chip '即時反映（hot）' (line 243). Design doc §7/§8.3/§8.4 stale markers corrected ([提案]→[実装済], 共有『重』→hot, in the diff). Mock (all states + greyed) and real-browser e2e (drives available→installed→shared against real backend on isolated dev port 8204) both pass with exit 0.

green-smoke.json credibly demonstrates a REAL nixos-rebuild + infisical RUNNING inside a container on the real appliance: specific store paths (palmux2-0.13.0), real container name (clinical-hishow-mirante-demo-...), generation hashes before/after (j9aj474... → brj3wigp...), and the load-bearing check done TWICE — pre-install `incus exec <ctr> -- /opt/palmux-nix-bin/coreutils --version`=9.7 and post-install `incus exec <ctr> -- infisical --version`=0.41.1 by both absolute path and profile PATH. This is internally consistent and detailed in a way fabricated/mock logs usually are not; I judge it a genuine real-appliance run. TWO honest caveats, both DISCLOSED (not hidden): (1) the appliance.nix state-init chown of local/ to the palmux user (in the diff, appliance.nix:388) CANNOT ship mid-sprint, so green hand-prepared `chown -R palmux:users /persist/palmux/nixos/local` — disclosed in green-smoke.json method + steps.prep AND decisions.json implementation_decisions[2]/[green]. (2) The AC text says '一連を実ブラウザで確認' but on green the flow was driven by API+incus exec ('real browser-equivalent API+incus flow'), not a literal browser; the literal real-BROWSER run was on the non-NixOS dev instance (which does not actually rebuild). Neither single run is 'real browser + real appliance' simultaneously. The decomposition is defensible (the browser UI is the same code proven on dev; the load-bearing 'installed tool runs in container' risk is not browser-dependent and IS proven on green) and honestly disclosed, but the literal AC wording was not met exactly and the AC-3-3 evidence is operator-attested JSON, not a machine-captured transcript.
findings.recommended_action: Accept as-is (real risk resolved + honestly disclosed). Optional follow-up: once appliance.nix state-init ships, re-run the green flow through a literal real browser end-to-end to close the wording gap.

No compromises.json exists for this sprint. The two material caveats (green chown hand-prep for the unreleasable appliance.nix state-init change; green flow driven by API/incus rather than a literal browser) are BOTH disclosed in decisions.json + green-smoke.json — not hidden.
